data.one_liner: A template engine for generating Microsoft Word .docx files.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to load a Microsoft Word template containing custom content control tags and generate a populated .docx file by passing structured content like text, lists, tables, and images.
use_when: You need to programmatically generate filled Word documents (.docx) from templates.
Your workflow relies on Microsoft Word content control tags.
avoid_when: You need to use LibreOffice or other office programs that lack a content control tag system.
You need to edit documents outside of Microsoft Word's tag creation toolset.
strengths: Supports lists, tables, text, plain blocks, images, and hyperlinks.
Compatible across multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Allows custom tag and image policies during generation.
weaknesses: Requires Microsoft Word to set up and edit content control tags.
LibreOffice and other non-Word office programs are not supported.
data.setup_notes: Requires downloading a template file, opening it in Microsoft Word, enabling Developer mode, and configuring content control tags.
